audio_processing: Phrase-level native synthesis rates0.74–0.93; explicit custom brand lexicon; voiced-RMS gain matching and mild compression/EQ, plus3dB overall gain with oversampled transient limiting and compensated lookahead; no time stretching, pitch shift, denoising or reverb.

method.execution: local CPU int8; cached models; offline=True

speech_recognition.classification_note: Brand spellings and the hear/here homophone are not classified as pronunciation errors. A recognizer disagreement alone does not prove a speech defect.

cue16_resolution.assessment: The final onset preserves approximately 100 ms of high-frequency nonperiodic frication before the vowel; the earlier pre-fricative voiced burst is removed.

limitations: ASR is diagnostic, not a substitute for subjective listening.
